admit site vm of f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01 as paisans-f2a9 on fake (ubuntu 24.04)

step 5: skip the mesh until its conf exists
step 6: start paisans-f2a9's manager after the mesh
step 7: delegate cgroups to users

step 12: load br_netfilter at boot
step 13: write paisans-f2a9's daemon.json

step 15: create /srv/paisans
step 16: create /srv/paisans/f2a9
step 17: create /etc/wireguard
step 18: create /usr/local/libexec/paisans
step 19: install the WireGuard helper
step 20: install the helper's sudoers line

step 21: allow 51820/udp
  firewall: allow 51820/udp (WireGuard, the mesh)
  run:
    $ ufw allow 51820/udp comment 'paisans-f2a9: WireGuard, the mesh'

step 22: allow all inbound on psns-f2a9
  firewall: allow all inbound on psns-f2a9 (the mesh: etcd, Patroni, Garage, HAProxy)
  run:
    $ ufw allow in on psns-f2a9 comment 'paisans-f2a9: the mesh: etcd, Patroni, Garage, HAProxy'

step 23: arm the ufw fallback
  firewall: a timer, paisans-ufw-fallback.timer, that runs ufw disable 10 minutes from now, so a login ufw blocks is let back in; admit stops it once a new SSH login gets through. It does not survive a reboot: a reboot before it fires leaves ufw enabled, so wait for it rather than reboot
  run:
    $ systemd-run --on-active=600 --timer-property=AccuracySec=1s --unit=paisans-ufw-fallback ufw disable

step 24: enable ufw
  firewall: enable ufw, every rule above already in place, with the default policy ufw has (Ubuntu's denies incoming). Admit allows only the TCP ports sshd listens on, and names every other port that answers from off this host as it reads it. It cannot see DROP rules written by hand in /etc/ufw/before.rules, before6.rules or user.rules, nor a way in that is not listening as it reads the host, such as sslh, dropbear or mosh started later: if you rely on either, enable ufw by hand after checking them. Stays reachable: 22/tcp (sshd (pid 812, uid 0) listens on 0.0.0.0:22 and sshd (pid 812, uid 0) listens on [::]:22), sshd's port, which admit keeps allowed.
  run:
    $ ufw --force enable

step 25: set the host's sysctls
step 26: write the admission record
step 27: add the operators' keys

warning: delegation reaches paisans-f2a9's manager at its next start
  Its manager is running, and restarting it would restart its Docker daemon and every container in it, so admit does not. cpuset and io limits apply after the host's next reboot.
warning: forwarding: this turns on routing between every interface on this host
  The site has an endpoint, so it relays mesh traffic between sites behind NAT, which cannot dial each other. The firewall's forward policy governs what is routed.
